The '''Sundari Bridge''' was a bridge located at the northern edge of the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], spanning the river valley that formed the northeastern border of the Flatlands.
